song.author: CFN Worship Music, Naomi Cantwell, Laura Souguellis, Brandin Reed, Roberto Bautista, Murilo Schiappadini
song.lyrics:
[V1] Praise and Thanksgiving Lyrics
[V2] Verse 1 Sing to the Lord a new song Let us sing about His Name Glory and honour and strength Belong to Jesus Sing to the Lord all the earth Let us shout about His Name All of the nations will come To bring Him praises
[V3] Pre-Chorus Shout for the things He has done His blood has opened the way for us
[V4] Chorus We enter Your gates with Praise and thanksgiving Praise and thanksgiving To lift You up We enter Your courts with Hearts awakened to You Hearts awakened to You To bless You Lord
[V5] Verse 2 Sing to the lord all the earth Let us shout about His Name All of thе nations will come To bring Him praises
[V6] Pre-Chorus Shout for the victory's won Nothing can keep us from His grеat love
[V7] Chorus We enter Your gates with Praise and thanksgiving Praise and thanksgiving To lift You up We enter Your courts with Hearts awakened to You Hearts awakened to You To bless You Lord We enter Your gates with Praise and thanksgiving Praise and thanksgiving To lift You up We enter Your courts with Hearts awakened to You Hearts awakened to You To bless You Lord
[V8] Interlude
